label: Cisco Catalyst 1300 C1300-16FP-2G
description: Cisco Catalyst 1300 C1300-16FP-2G - 16x 10/100/1000BASE-T PoE+ RJ-45 (802.3af/at, 30 W per port) on a 240 W budget plus 2 x 1G SFP uplinks, 36 Gbps switching capacity, 26.78 Mpps, fanless, managed L3.

fabric.note: Cisco Table 1 states 36 Gbps switching capacity and 26.78 Mpps forwarding rate for the C1300-16FP-2G, the full-duplex aggregate of every port at line rate (16 x 1G downlinks plus 2 x 1G SFP), so nothing is oversubscribed (https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/collateral/switches/catalyst-1300-series-switches/nb-06-cat1300-ser-data-sheet-cte-en.pdf).

notes: Datasheet Table 1 and the model comparison table: 16 x 10/100/1000BASE-T downlinks plus 2 x 1G SFP uplinks; 36 Gbps switching capacity, 26.78 Mpps forwarding rate, 1.5 MB shared packet buffer, 512 MB flash, ARM dual-core CPU, 1 GB DDR4, 16 K MAC entries, up to 4094 VLANs, 8 LACP groups. PoE: the datasheet PoE table gives 240 W dedicated to PoE across 16 ports at 30 W PoE+ (802.3at) each, with 802.3af also supported; worst-case power at 110 V is 20.6 W system-only and 281.9 W with PoE loaded. Cooling: Fanless per the comparison table. No stacking on this SKU: the datasheet hardware-stacking list names only the 4X and MGP models, and the model comparison table prints N/A for this one. Management: Cisco Business Dashboard and mobile app, on-device web UI, CLI and SNMPv1/v2c/v3, per the comparison table; the datasheet also states dual images, a DHCP server, RIP v2, static routing and PBR. Ports live in the Gi1/0/x space the uplinks continue from, because the datasheet prints a total of 18 Ethernet ports for this model; the RJ-45 console port and the USB Type C port are both front-panel per the datasheet hardware table. Sources: https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/collateral/switches/catalyst-1300-series-switches/nb-06-cat1300-ser-data-sheet-cte-en.pdf and https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/switches/catalyst-1300-series-switches/models-comparison.html.
